## Use this capability when the user means

- join a local business rewards network
- create cross-business loyalty rewards
- make my local business more discoverable
- join a community business partnership program

## Authority

public discovery and reversible owner-confirmed enrollment intent through Evercraft Machine Commerce

## Boundaries

- prepared enrollment does not activate a merchant
- prepared enrollment creates no payment obligation
- directory publication and commercial activation require their own verified state

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
